作案手法
五名中国男子，其中一人持手枪，强征了一辆工务局（P.W.D.）卡车，上海公共租界（S.J.C.）牌照号18966，并绑架了同车的一名中国男子朱承山（Sz Zung Sai，音译），该受害者在被绑架前即为该车乘客。
（批注：W.T. Loh 1911年3月9日）

pages.en:
At 5.40a.m. 29-7-41, the informant namely Loh
au Yoong (陸朝榮), H/P.W.D. chauffeur visited
Gordon Road Police Station and reported that a P.W.D.
coolie supervisor named Sz Tung Sai (朱永山), age
39 years, native of Ningpo had been kidnapped and
one P.W.D. truck S.M.C. Lic. No. 15266 had been
commandeered.

Subsequent enquiries by C.D.F. 293 and the
undersigned ascertained the following:-

At about 5.20a.m. 29-7-41, whilst the informant
Loh Sau Yoong was driving motor truck S.M.C. Lic.
No. 15266 South to North along Yenping Road about
20 yards North of Connaught Road 5 male Chinese
one of whom was armed with a pistol, ordered the
chauffeur to stop then ejected him and two other
P.W.D. coolies namely Dai Yoong Ling (戴榮林) and
Ling Sung (凌森) from the vehicle but refused
to allow the supervisor named Sz Tung Sai to alight
from the motor-car.

Culprits then boarded the motor truck and one
of the former drove same away in a westerly direction
together with Sz Tung Sai.

When the incident happened the P.W. D. staff
were returning from Seymour Road some being a daily
occurrence.

No shots fired, No Alarm raised, Kempo dialect.
The informant and witnesses stated that they
were unable to give any description of the kidnappers
this however is possibly not due to their inability

1941年7月29日上午5:40，报案人即陆朝荣（Loh au Yoong，原文拼写有误，应为Loh Sau Yoong），工务局（P.W.D.）司机，前往戈登路警察局报案，称一名名为朱永山（Sz Tung Sai，音译，对应中文名可能为朱永山或朱承山）、39岁、宁波籍的工务局苦力监工被绑架，且一辆工务局卡车，上海公共租界（S.M.C.）牌照号15266被强征。

经刑事侦缉队（C.D.F.）293号警员及本人随后的调查，查明如下情况：-

约在1941年7月29日上午5:20，当报案人陆朝荣驾驶上海公共租界（S.M.C.）牌照号15266的卡车沿延平路由南向北行驶至康纳路以北约20码处时，5名中国男子（其中一人持手枪）命令司机停车，随后将司机及另外两名工务局苦力，即戴荣林（Dai Yoong Ling，音译）和凌森（Ling Sung，音译）赶下车，但拒绝让名为朱永山（Sz Tung Sai，音译）的监工下车。

罪犯随即登上卡车，其中一人驾车连同朱永山一起向西驶离。

事件发生时，工务局（P.W. D.）职员正从西摩路（Seymour Road）返回，此类情况每日均有发生。

未开枪，未发出警报，讲肯波方言（Kempo dialect，音译，疑为宁波话或特定地方方言的误记）。
报案人及证人表示无法提供绑匪的任何体貌特征，但这可能并非由于他们无法

July 30, 1941. 1007
30 7/III
Public Works Department - Chinese supervisor of Yenping
Road Depot kidnapped.

At about 5.30 a.m., July 29, one TSU ZUNG SAN
( 朱 承 山 ), while proceeding in P.W.D. motor car
No.15266, was held up on Yenping Road near Connaught Road
and taken away by a gang of four persons. His whereabouts
remain unknown, but the motor car was discovered at
Amherst Avenue during the same forenoon.

TSU ZUNG SAN is the Chinese supervisor attached
to Yenping Road Depot of the Highway Division of the Public
Works Department, S.M.C. It will be remembered that he
was the recipient of a number of anonymous letters containing
threats against his life. Shortly before his abduction, he
is said to have received a letter of a similar nature, but
he appeared to pay little attention to the matter. While
the motive for his abduction remains uncertain, it is
worthy of mention that he has incurred displeasure of the
P.W.D. Coolies' Union, because of his non-cooperative
attitude. The P.W.D. Coolies' Union is located at 59
Jukong Road, Chapei and was organized with the approval
of the Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee, 527 Range Road.

The situation in the Yenping Road Depot is normal.

1941年7月30日。 1007
30 7/III
工务局 - 延平路车场华籍监工被绑架。

1941年7月29日上午5:30左右，朱承山（TSU ZUNG SAN，音译）乘坐工务局（P.W.D.）第15266号汽车，在康纳路附近的延平路上被一伙四人拦劫并带走。其下落至今不明，但该汽车于当天上午在安赫斯特大道（Amherst Avenue）被发现。

朱承山系上海公共租界（S.M.C.）工务局道路处延平路车场的华籍监工。众所周知，他曾收到多封含有生命威胁的匿名信。据称，在被绑架前不久，他又收到了一封类似性质的信件，但他似乎对此未加重视。虽然其被绑架的动机尚不确定，但值得一提的是，由于其不合作的态度，他引起了工务局苦力工会的不满。工务局苦力工会位于闸北菊康路59号，该工会是经社会运动指导委员会上海分会（兰恩路527号）批准成立的。

延平路车场的局势正常。
